name: v278_gross_income_level_only
hypothesis: The v277 gross-income signal may have been diluted by a low-coverage dispersion sleeve; pure consensus gross income scaled by assets tests the parent strength directly.

name: v278_gross_income_delivery_surprise
hypothesis: Positive actual gross income relative to consensus can reveal cost pass-through or demand quality before it appears in crowded EPS and EBIT surfaces.

name: v278_gross_income_revision_slow
hypothesis: Upward revision in expected gross income should capture improving unit economics without directly using EPS, EBIT, or operating-income carriers.

name: v278_gross_income_guidance_floor
hypothesis: A strong minimum gross-income guidance floor may indicate management confidence in cost pass-through and revenue quality.

name: v278_gross_income_guidance_confidence
hypothesis: High gross-income guidance floor combined with a narrow guidance range should represent confidence rather than generic scale.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.75 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_minguidance / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), industry), -1)
